commands.author: qingminlong

target.title: fix(browser): time out download saves
target.body:
## What Problem This Solves

Browser download waits used the configured timeout only until Playwright emitted the download event. After that event, the timer stayed active, but an already-started `download.saveAs(...)` could still finish later and publish the requested output path after the browser tool call had already timed out.

## Why This Change Was Made

The download capture now carries the deadline cancellation state into the save path and checks it immediately before the atomic output publication step. A slow or delayed Playwright save can still finish its temporary write, but it cannot publish the final output after the waiter has timed out or been cancelled.

## User Impact

Browser download tools now fail with the configured timeout when Playwright cannot finish saving in time, and timed-out downloads no longer create the requested output file later after the tool has already reported failure.

## Evidence

- Current head `78a30bd85a9543bc89cbd685483f2e00762b685f` passed `node scripts/run-vitest.mjs extensions/browser/src/browser/pw-tools-core.waits-next-download-saves-it.test.ts`: 1 test file passed; 12 tests passed and 3 skipped.
- Current head `78a30bd85a9543bc89cbd685483f2e00762b685f` passed `git diff --check HEAD^ HEAD`.
- Real Playwright Chromium proof on Node `v24.18.0` exercised the current `createDownloadCaptureForPage` implementation with a real browser download. The proof patched the real Playwright `Download.saveAs(...)` for that download so the save completed only after the configured deadline rejected the waiter, then verified neither the temporary output nor the requested final output remained:

```text
proof-head: 78a30bd85a9543bc89cbd685483f2e00762b685f
real-download-url: http://127.0.0.1:62968/download
patched-saveAs-temp-basename: .fs-safe-output-33d0b278-12da-4936-9c3a-51ff04636159-artifact.bin.part
observed-rejection: Timeout waiting for download
elapsed-ms: 124
saveAs-call-count: 1
temp-output-exists-after-late-save: false
final-output-exists-after-late-save: false
proof-result: PASS late Playwright download save did not publish after timeout
```
